provenance.locations: real Budapest addresses from OpenStreetMap Overpass; depot 47.405N 19.11E (district 23)
provenance.distances: haversine x 1.3 winding factor, km rounded to 3 decimals (not road routing)
provenance.furniture: furniture_clean.csv (Amazon listing scrape, inches->m); order volume = sum of item bounding boxes
provenance.schedule_speed: model.schedule_average_speed_kmh = fleet mean 47.20; per-vehicle avg_speed_kmh kept in vehicles[].speed_kmh
provenance.warning: Vehicle wages, speeds, maintenance and cargo dimensions are the PSO team's stated assumptions.
provenance.reference_transports: nearest-neighbour tour, greedy capacity split, round-robin fleet; neutral start for both teams
provenance.active_distances: road_network and duration_matrix_s; original source distances are superseded

pso_reference_solution.note: Reference trip vehicle assignments and customer visit orders are unchanged. Timing, distance, fuel and evaluator cost now use this road file. Original reported approximate-matrix cost is retained only as historical provenance.
pso_reference_solution.comparison_status: Same published PSO-team routes rescheduled and re-evaluated on this road matrix; not a new PSO optimization run; never a GA initialization seed

original_non_road_audit.basis: Original PSO-team approximate haversine x 1.3 matrix; not the road evaluation below

pso_reference_solution.reported_cost_basis: true_cost_eur_reported remains the original approximate-matrix published value for provenance only; use cost.real_cost_eur / true_cost_eur_ours for the road re-evaluation

road_network.profile: simplified motorcar graph; common to all vehicles
road_network.path_objective: estimated travel time; distance measured along the SAME selected path
limitations: Not OpenRouteService; no turn restriction relations or HGV-specific clearance
Static road-class speed assumptions capped by parseable maxspeed; no live traffic
Address-to-road-vertex offsets are audited but not charged as drivable road legs
Finite extract may exclude better routes; connectivity does not prove boundary independence
Addresses are from shared source; parking/unloading accessibility is not verified
